title: Agreement with a fixed assignment
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $z$ assign a sign to every coordinate in $P$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The point $x$ matches $z$ on $P$ exactly when $x_i=z_i$ for every $i\in P$.
